name: Offering to the Wild
body:
School abjuration; Level druid 4, ranger 3, shaman 4, witch 4

CAST

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a sacrificial animal or other suitable sacrifice)

EFFECT

Range touc.

Targets 1 willing touched creature/caster level
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You complete the sacrifice and anoint each creature to be protected with some part of the sacrifice, typically blood or ash, leaving the rest to the spirits of nature.

For the duration the protected creatures gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks while in the terrain that the spell was cast in.

The terrain is determined similarly to a ranger’s favored terrain and stacks with the effects of that ability.

Additionally, any animal or magical beast native to the affected wilds begins with a neutral disposition and will not run from nor attack a protected creature, unless attacked first or impelled by some outside means. This spell cannot be used on urban terrain.
